description: Talal Alshihayb and colleagues publish R code and public inputs for comparing dental-facility access by car and multimodal transit in Riyadh, Saudi Arabia. The July 2026 archive includes facility inventories, district and transit layers, route sequences and analysis modules. Code is MIT and author data CC BY 4.0; third-party layers retain their own terms. Downloads are free. The README describes 910 health facilities, including 766 providing dental services, and R 4.5.2 with geospatial dependencies. These inputs support accessibility and travel-time simulations under alternative waits, walking speeds and car conditions. District population is withheld, so population-weighted results cannot be fully regenerated from public data; external OSM inputs are also required. No related catalogue record explicitly covers this implementation. The separate field-census dataset is an upstream dependency. Code and performance claims were not independently tested.
